rationale: Repair archive-slice-bounds mutation: restore the required surrogate-pair boundary handling. An interior end must move backward before a split surrogate pair (cases 15-23: "xy😀z", offset 0, max_chars 3 must return "xy" with next_offset 2, not reject). The mutation dropped the end adjustment, so the post-check need(end>offset||offset===text.length) no longer rejects a nonempty read that cannot make progress without splitting a pair, and interior ends were returned as split. The fix re-adds the single backward adjustment of end when splitPair(end) holds, leaving offset validation (interior start rejection via slice/splitPair contract, EOF empty slice allowed), export, return fields, and unrelated behavior untouched.
